profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Collibra
profile.summary: Software developer with experience in data governance applications and a strong background in mathematics.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developer for Knowledge Graph Engine team as part of new initiatives around databases and microservices.
- Search team developer with focus on transitioning from on-prem to cloud services. Lead work on machine learning integrations.

positions.title: Advisory Software Developer
positions.description:
- Backend developer for data microservice in offerings on public and private cloud, with additional work in performance.
- Technical lead for bulk load. Subject matter expert for Elasticsearch, JanusGraph, and Spark job development.
- Primary contributor to utilities for automated testing and internal documentation.

positions.title: Staff Software Developer
positions.description:
- Full-stack developer for multiple Big Data offerings with emphasis on graph layer.
- Primary developer for metadata discovery, composite view, and search.
- Responsible for transition to Elasticsearch and for best utilizing latest JanusGraph.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Full-stack developer on Big Data offering, focusing on workflow performance and UI accessibility.
- Translated data science mock-ups into equivalent matching engine code.

positions.title: Co-op (Master Data Management)
positions.description:
- Worked on algorithms projects for entity-linkage
- Worked with data scientist to improve data generation utilities for performance tests.

positions.title: IT Intern (Enterprise Data Warehouse)
positions.description:
- Developed Web-based app for Global Information Services on a team of four
- Code manager for full-stack, cross-platform app supporting optical character recognition.
- Programmer for front-end code and minification of existing code

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Responsible for explaining theory and techniques to refine competency in Calculus II
- Taught weekly recitation, designed quizzes, and offered additional tutoring for students

positions.title: Student Technician
positions.description: - Translated Calculus I Maple projects into Sage for wider accessibility
